synchronized_upstream.result: The v1.7 branch is synchronized to the latest fetched upstream/main. PR #850 added OSM as the seventh background-only registry source without changing PROV-SITE-001, and PR #842 added native Markdown rendering. required_inputs_reviewed.finding: Participation is a return-pass loop; credible external data may be used when source, purpose, permission and limits are registered, while privacy, non-public planning and unauthorized data are prohibited.
Intentional narrative updates use proposal format v2 with claim-adjacent evidence; new bilingual packages declare contract version 1 and pair every text-bearing deliverable.
The open call welcomes continuing, reviewable proposals; repository intake is not award selection, implementation approval or government endorsement.
The six agent tasks require a complete, spatially explicit, transferable and publicly compliant design package.

The canonical registry now contains seven sources, including the PR #850 OSM record classified as background_only. Package-local official or open-licensed records retain explicit use and prohibited-use boundaries.

Format v2 keeps prose readable while structured files retain exhaustive evidence; strict bilingual mapping remains binding. Advisory proposal scoring does not establish readiness, so can_enter_formal_review and formal-review-ready from the full self-check are the required admission evidence.

change_triggers.trigger: Official boundary, key-area, road, rail, ownership, heritage, waterway, utility or statutory-control data changes.
change_triggers.required_action: Replace provisional inputs, rerun every spatial calculation and regenerate all figures, reports and drawings.

change_triggers.trigger: Authorized corridor mobility or platform data becomes available with method, time, coverage, license and bias documentation.
change_triggers.required_action: Register the source, keep raw and transformed values separable, and reopen the relevant transport gate.

change_triggers.trigger: Resident, accessibility-user, operator or rights-holder feedback identifies a material safety, access, privacy or attribution failure.
change_triggers.required_action: Pause the affected pilot or display, record the negative result and obtain Human Review before any restart.

change_triggers.trigger: Repository guidance, renderer behavior, schema, validation scripts, Issues or pull-request review changes.
change_triggers.required_action: Sync upstream, reread changed inputs, update only affected outputs and rerun self-check plus participant preflight.
